description: AI model prices per million tokens (input, output, cache, batch) with context window, for about 4,000 models across providers. With model=: its price history and the same model on other providers. Without: a list filtered by provider, mode, min_context and max_input price, sorted by input, output or context. History from January 2026. Source: LiteLLM's open price file (MIT). Signed. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).
name: ai_prices
